subject.title: Feature: Support Telegram media groups (albums) in message tool

question: Should OpenClaw add Telegram album delivery now, and should maintainers port the open external draft PR or request a fresh current-main implementation?
rationale: Current main only provides sequential multi-media sends; adding album behavior changes the Telegram message-tool surface and transport semantics, so the action/parameter shape and fallback policy need maintainer intent before automation should open a separate fix PR.

options.title: Port a bounded Telegram plugin implementation
options.body: Adopt or rewrite the useful external PR idea against current main, using sendMediaGroup only for eligible album groups and preserving existing sequential fallbacks.

options.title: Request a fresh current-main PR
options.body: Ask contributors to replace the stale external draft with a narrow in-repo PR that includes tests, docs, and live Telegram proof.

options.title: Keep sequential sends only
options.body: Decide that grouped albums are out of scope for now and close or mark the feature as not planned, leaving current mediaUrls fan-out as the supported behavior.

recommendation.title: Port a bounded Telegram plugin implementation
recommendation.body: Adopt or rewrite the useful external PR idea against current main, using sendMediaGroup only for eligible album groups and preserving existing sequential fallbacks.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete already handled maintainer cleanup on this issue and has the strongest sampled Telegram plugin history signal.
